slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 rose 0.86% to 7,656.98 today, a solid broad rally, but the day was overshadowed by a hotter than expected inflation report. Press coverage confirms core CPI came in at 0.3% for August, above the 0.2% forecast, and overall prices are up 3.4% year over year, partly driven by energy costs tied to the Iran war. That pushed the odds of a Fed rate hike next week sharply higher, with traders now pricing an 87% chance of an increase according to the Wall Street Journal. Next week is the Fed meeting, so that decision will set the tone for the rest of the month.
